title: CTRES v1.0 R7 Reconciliation Statement
description: Location and coverage statements that turn reconciliation from a claim into a number (§4.7). The custody model declared in R1 selects the reconciliation profile.

kind.description: Kind of statement: one location statement per funds location per period, and one coverage statement per licence per period, or per day where the profile requires (§4.7).

currency_or_asset.description: Currency or asset in which the statement's amounts are stated (§4.7; §3 Currency-aware).

location_id.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

external_source_type.description: Kind of external source the balances were taken from (§4.7; §6 External evidence for reconciliation).
external_source_type.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

opening_balance_external.description: Opening balance from the external source: bank statement, provider settlement report, mobile operator statement or chain (§4.7).
opening_balance_external.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

closing_balance_external.description: Closing balance from the external source (§4.7).
closing_balance_external.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

opening_balance_ledger.description: Opening balance in the operator's ledger (§4.7).
opening_balance_ledger.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

closing_balance_ledger.description: Closing balance in the operator's ledger (§4.7).
closing_balance_ledger.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

opening_balance_provider.description: Opening balance reported by the provider (§4.7).
opening_balance_provider.x-ctres-condition: Location statements where the location's custody_model in R1 is omnibus_at_provider (§4.7).

closing_balance_provider.description: Closing balance reported by the provider (§4.7).
closing_balance_provider.x-ctres-condition: Location statements where the location's custody_model in R1 is omnibus_at_provider (§4.7).

inflow_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

outflow_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

fees_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

unexplained_delta.description: The unexplained delta at period end, external less ledger, stated rather than hidden (§4.7).
unexplained_delta.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; not used on coverage statements (§4.7).

unexplained_delta_reporting_ccy.description: The unexplained delta in the reporting currency (§4.7; §3 Currency-aware).

exception_ids.description: R8 exceptions raised for the statement; an empty list states that none were raised (§4.7).
exception_ids.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on location statements; optional on coverage statements (§4.7).

player_balances_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on coverage statements; not used on location statements (§4.7).

pending_withdrawals_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on coverage statements; not used on location statements (§4.7).

open_bets_total.x-ctres-condition: Coverage statements where the profile counts open bets in player liabilities (§4.7).

player_liability_total.description: Total player liabilities: player balances, pending withdrawals and, where counted, open bets (§4.7).
player_liability_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on coverage statements; not used on location statements (§4.7).

funds_held.description: Funds held against player liabilities, by protection mechanism (§4.7). Keys are protection_mechanism values.
funds_held.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on coverage statements; not used on location statements (§4.7).

in_transit_total.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on coverage statements; not used on location statements (§4.7).

shortfall.description: Shortfall of funds held against liabilities; zero where there is none (§4.7).
shortfall.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory on coverage statements; not used on location statements (§4.7).

shortfall_cured_at.x-ctres-condition: Coverage statements with a shortfall greater than zero that has been cured (§4.7).

evidence_refs.description: References to the supporting statements retained (§4.7; §7).
